changelog: Pump and charger sessions are paid up front and refunded for what was not used
Delivery deposits, cancels and unload times are checked on the server
Stock cost is refunded if the driver disconnects mid delivery
Station prices, identity and staff changes require being at the station
Fuel drain only runs while driving and syncs less often
Dashboard updates only go to players who have it open
Station saves are batched and flushed on resource stop
Employee permission now works and fired staff stay removed after a restart
Card payments for jerry cans use the bank account on ESX
